1) we introduce a novel method to train a network that can be executed at different widths at inference time, 2) we show that our method achieves similar or better accuracy than networks trained individually at different widths, 3) we show that the same slimmable network can be applied to different tasks, and 4) our method can be used to understand what features are learned in a network.

the following questions:
How to train a neural network with switchable widths?
What are the benefits and challenges of training slimmable networks?

How to visualize and interpret slimmable networks?

the following questions: How to train one single neural network that can adapt to different resource constraints at runtime? Can the network be trained in an end-to-end manner without re-training or fine-tuning?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the paper presents a simple, yet powerful and generalizable method for training a single network that can be executed at different widths (i.e., numbers of channels in a convolutional layer) at runtime.
we present a simple and flexible method that can train a single neural networks that can be dynamically resized to different widths at run time.
we present a simple and effective method to train a neural network that is executable at different widths.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
slimmable neural network is a general method to train and deploy a single neural network at different widths, which achieves similar or better performance than individual ones.

we present a simple and efficient method to train a shared neural network executable at multiple widths, which can adapt to the available resources and achieve the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off at runtime.
we propose slimmable neural network which can be used to trade off accuracy for efficiency at runtime.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a single slimmable neural network trained with switchable batch norm can be dynamically adjusted to different widths, and achieve comparable performance to individually trained networks at different widths.
a single slimmable network is more flexible than individual models with different width configurations.
a single slimmable network can be trained and used to achieve a wide range of accuracies at different widths, and the width can be changed at runtime.
